topics.concept: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline answers questions by first retrieving relevant passages from a knowledge base and then generating an answer grounded in them. Retrieval uses embedding similarity between the query and document chunks. The basic pipeline has four stages: ingest, embed, retrieve, and generate, each independently testable.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents and questions with known answers, then measures answer accuracy end to end.
topics.name: RAG Pipeline Basics
topics.real_world_use: Enterprise search assistants answer employee questions from internal docs.

topics.concept: Chunking decides how documents are split before embedding: fixed-size windows, sentence boundaries, or semantic breaks. Good chunks keep related ideas together so retrieval finds complete answers. The lab compares strategies on the same corpus and scores retrieval hit rate per strategy.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents with known answer spans and compares chunking strategies on retrieval recall.
topics.name: Chunking Strategies Lab
topics.real_world_use: Document search systems tune chunking to improve answer quality.

topics.concept: An embedding pipeline converts text chunks into dense vectors that capture meaning, then stores them with metadata for retrieval. Normalization and batching keep the pipeline fast and the similarity math correct. The simulation tracks throughput and embedding quality on a seeded corpus.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded text chunks and simulates embeddings with controlled noise, then checks similarity rankings.
topics.name: Embedding Pipeline Sim
topics.real_world_use: Search and recommendation systems build vector indexes from document collections.

topics.concept: A document ingestion pipeline loads raw files, extracts clean text, splits it into chunks, and indexes the embeddings with metadata. Format handlers deal with PDFs, spreadsheets, and HTML quirks. Idempotent re-ingestion updates changed documents without duplicating the index.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded multi-format documents and verifies text extraction and dedup on re-ingest.
topics.name: Document Ingestion Pipeline
topics.real_world_use: Knowledge-base products onboard customer documents automatically.

topics.concept: An FAQ retrieval bot matches user questions to a curated question-answer collection using semantic similarity. Paraphrase handling lets it recognize the same question asked different ways. Below the confidence threshold it asks a clarifying question instead of answering.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded FAQs plus paraphrased variants and measures match accuracy.

key_params.clarify_threshold: confidence below which to ask for clarification

topics.name: FAQ Retrieval Bot
topics.real_world_use: Support portals answer common questions instantly from FAQ collections.

topics.concept: A PDF Q&A simulator extracts text from seeded PDF-like documents, chunks it, and answers questions with page citations. Layout quirks such as headers, footers, and tables are stripped during cleaning. Citation fidelity is the key metric: every claim must point at the right page.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded multi-page documents with known facts per page and checks citation accuracy.

key_params.clean_headers: whether to strip headers and footers

topics.name: PDF Q&A System Sim
topics.real_world_use: Research tools let users query long PDF reports conversationally.

topics.concept: A support knowledge-base search ranks help articles by semantic relevance to the user's problem description. Article metadata like product version and category filters results to applicable ones. Click-through simulation measures whether top results resolve the issue.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded articles and problem descriptions with known correct articles, then measures ranking quality.
topics.name: Support Knowledge Base Search
topics.real_world_use: Help centers surface the right troubleshooting article for each issue.

topics.concept: A recipe Q&A search answers cooking questions from a recipe collection: ingredient substitutions, timing, and technique lookups. Structured fields like cook time and dietary tags combine with semantic search for precise filtering. Unit conversion handles metric and imperial recipes transparently.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded recipes with tags and verifies filtered search and substitution answers.
topics.name: Recipe Q&A Search
topics.real_world_use: Cooking apps answer substitution and timing questions from recipe databases.

topics.concept: Metadata-filtered search combines vector similarity with hard filters on fields like date, author, or category. Pre-filtering narrows the candidate set before similarity ranking, which is both faster and more precise. The simulation shows how selective filters change recall.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents with rich metadata and compares filtered versus unfiltered retrieval precision.
topics.name: Metadata-Filtered Search
topics.real_world_use: Legal and research search restricts results by jurisdiction, date, or author.

topics.concept: A citation tracker records exactly which retrieved passages support each sentence of a generated answer. Uncited sentences are flagged so users can spot unsupported claims. Coverage scoring measures what fraction of the answer is backed by sources.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded Q&A with known supporting passages and checks citation completeness.
topics.name: Citation Tracker
topics.real_world_use: Compliance-sensitive assistants prove every claim with a source link.

topics.concept: A chunk-overlap tuner searches for the overlap size that maximizes retrieval recall without bloating the index. Too little overlap splits answers across chunks; too much wastes storage and slows search. The tuner sweeps overlap values on a seeded corpus and plots the recall curve.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents with answer spans at chunk boundaries and sweeps overlap to find the optimum.
topics.name: Chunk Overlap Tuner
topics.real_world_use: Search engineers tune ingestion settings for maximum answer recall.

topics.concept: Hybrid search fuses dense vector similarity with classic keyword scoring, getting the best of semantic and exact matching. A fusion weight balances the two signals, and normalization puts their scores on a comparable scale. The simulation shows hybrid beating either signal alone on mixed query types.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded queries split between keyword-heavy and semantic-heavy, and compares fusion weights.
topics.name: Hybrid Search Engine
topics.real_world_use: E-commerce and docs search blend keyword and semantic ranking.

topics.concept: Query expansion rewrites the user's question into several variants, including synonyms and related terms, before retrieval. Expanded queries catch documents phrased differently from the original question. Expansion count is tuned to avoid drifting off-topic with too many variants.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded queries with synonym-heavy documents and measures recall gain from expansion.
topics.name: Query Expansion Module
topics.real_world_use: Search engines broaden queries to catch differently-worded documents.

topics.concept: A context window packer fits retrieved passages into a fixed token budget by ranking, truncating, and deduplicating. Ordering strategies like putting the best passage first or last affect answer quality. The packer reports how much of the budget each passage consumed.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded passages with relevance scores and checks packing keeps the best ones within budget.
topics.name: Context Window Packer
topics.real_world_use: RAG systems assemble prompts that fit model limits without losing key evidence.

topics.concept: Parent-document retrieval searches small child chunks for precision but returns the full parent document for context. This gives the generator complete surrounding information instead of a fragment. Parent size and child size are tuned together for the corpus.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded parent documents with child chunks and checks answer completeness versus child-only retrieval.
topics.name: Parent Document Retrieval
topics.real_world_use: Technical documentation search returns full sections, not isolated snippets.

topics.concept: Sentence-window retrieval embeds individual sentences for precise matching but expands each hit to a window of neighboring sentences for context. Window size controls how much surrounding text the generator sees. This beats fixed chunks on corpora where answers sit inside longer passages.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents with answers inside long passages and compares window sizes on recall.
topics.name: Sentence Window Retrieval
topics.real_world_use: Long-form content search retrieves precise hits with readable context.

topics.concept: A reranking pipeline takes the top candidates from fast retrieval and re-scores them with a slower, more accurate cross-encoder model. The two-stage design keeps latency low while improving final ordering. Cutoff tuning decides how many candidates enter the expensive rerank stage.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded candidate lists with known relevance and measures ranking improvement from reranking.
topics.name: Reranking Pipeline
topics.real_world_use: Production search stacks rerank to lift precision of the final results.

topics.concept: A retrieval precision tuner runs a grid search over chunk size, overlap, and top-k to maximize precision at k on a labeled question set. It reports the best configuration plus sensitivity of each parameter. Cross-validation guards against overfitting the tuning set.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded labeled Q&A and sweeps parameters to find the best precision configuration.
topics.name: Retrieval Precision Tuner
topics.real_world_use: Search teams automate hyperparameter tuning for retrieval quality.

topics.concept: A knowledge-base sync tool watches source documents for changes and updates the index incrementally instead of rebuilding from scratch. Change detection hashes each document and re-embeds only what changed. Deletion handling removes stale vectors so retired documents stop appearing.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded document sets with edits and deletions, then verifies index freshness after sync.

key_params.sync_interval: how often to check for changes

topics.name: Knowledge Base Sync Tool
topics.real_world_use: Documentation platforms keep search indexes fresh as docs change.

topics.concept: A product manual Q&A answers how-to and troubleshooting questions from device manuals with section citations. Safety warnings are surfaced prominently when relevant to the question. The simulation checks that answers never contradict the manual's stated procedures.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded manuals with procedures and warnings, then checks answer fidelity and warning surfacing.
topics.name: Product Manual Q&A
topics.real_world_use: Hardware companies deflect support calls with manual-grounded assistants.

topics.concept: Hypothetical-document retrieval first generates a plausible ideal answer to the query, then searches for real documents similar to that hypothetical text. The hypothetical document bridges vocabulary gaps between the question and the corpus. Multiple hypotheticals can be averaged for stability.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded corpora with vocabulary mismatch to queries and measures recall gain from hypothetical docs.
topics.name: Hypothetical Document Queries
topics.real_world_use: Research search overcomes jargon mismatch between questions and papers.

topics.concept: Multi-hop question answering chains multiple retrieval rounds, where each round's findings shape the next query. Bridge questions require combining facts from separate documents that share an entity. The simulation tracks hop accuracy and where chains break.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded document graphs with bridge entities and checks multi-hop answer correctness.
topics.name: Multi-Hop Question Answering
topics.real_world_use: Analyst tools answer questions that span multiple reports and sources.

topics.concept: Table Q&A retrieval answers questions over tabular data by finding the right tables and rows before generating the answer. Schema descriptions guide the retriever to relevant columns. Aggregation questions are validated by recomputing from the retrieved rows.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tables with known aggregates and checks answers against recomputed values.
topics.name: Table Q&A Retrieval
topics.real_world_use: Business intelligence assistants answer questions over spreadsheets and data tables.

topics.concept: A code Q&A assistant answers questions about a codebase by retrieving relevant functions and documentation. Symbol-aware chunking keeps functions and classes intact instead of splitting mid-definition. Call-graph context adds the callers and callees of retrieved functions.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded codebases with known function behaviors and checks answer accuracy.
topics.name: Code Q&A Assistant
topics.real_world_use: Developer tools answer questions about unfamiliar codebases from their own source.

topics.concept: Legal document Q&A retrieves clauses from agreements and explains them in plain language with exact-quote citations. Jurisdiction metadata filters which documents apply to the question. The system refuses to give legal advice and frames answers as information only.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded agreements with planted clauses and checks citation precision and advice disclaimers.
topics.name: Legal Document Q&A
topics.real_world_use: Legal teams triage contract questions before involving counsel.

topics.concept: Medical FAQ retrieval answers health questions from curated, reviewed sources and always cites them. Confidence gating refuses to answer when sources are thin, directing users to professionals instead. The simulation strictly penalizes any answer that contradicts the seeded sources.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded medical FAQs with review status and checks citation and refusal behavior.
topics.name: Medical FAQ Retrieval
topics.real_world_use: Health information portals answer common questions from vetted content.

topics.concept: Academic paper Q&A retrieves across a corpus of papers, synthesizing findings and noting where papers agree or disagree. Citation format follows academic conventions with section references. Contradiction detection flags when sources make opposing claims.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded papers with planted agreements and disagreements, then checks synthesis quality.
topics.name: Academic Paper Q&A
topics.real_world_use: Literature review tools summarize what research says on a topic.

topics.concept: A policy document retriever answers employee questions about company policies with quotes from the official text. Version tracking ensures answers cite the current policy, not superseded ones. Effective-date filtering handles questions about rules that changed over time.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded policy versions with changes and checks that answers cite current text.
topics.name: Policy Document Retriever
topics.real_world_use: HR portals answer benefits and leave-policy questions from official documents.

topics.concept: Changelog Q&A search answers questions about what changed between software versions from release notes and commit summaries. Version-range queries aggregate changes across multiple releases. Breaking-change detection highlights migration-relevant entries.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded release histories and checks version-range aggregation accuracy.
topics.name: Changelog Q&A Search
topics.real_world_use: Developer portals answer what-changed questions across release histories.

topics.concept: A RAG evaluation harness scores retrieval and generation separately: hit rate and precision for retrieval, faithfulness and answer relevance for generation. Golden question-answer sets with known supporting passages make the scores trustworthy. Regression runs catch quality drops after pipeline changes.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded golden Q&A sets and reports component scores plus regression deltas.
topics.name: RAG Eval Harness
topics.real_world_use: Teams guard search quality with automated evaluation before each deploy.
